query_template: Run the IPO Filings Analysis workflow. Company: {{company}} Filing reference (EDGAR link, CIK, or accession number): {{filing_reference}} Uploaded filing documents: see the files attached to this turn Pricing status: {{pricing_status}} Analysis sections to emphasize: {{analysis_sections}} Comparable peers: {{comparable_peers}} Additional context: {{additional_context}} Preferred data source: {{data_source}} Output format: {{output_format}}

pages.title: IPO filing inputs
pages.description: Point the workflow at an S-1/F-1 issuer. It retrieves the registration statement and every amendment from SEC EDGAR, tracks what changed across amendments, and produces an investor-grade deal read with dilution math, valuation across the marketed range, and diligence questions.

fields.label: Company
fields.description: Issuer name, with reserved ticker if known. The workflow locates the registration statement on SEC EDGAR.

fields.label: Filing reference
fields.placeholder: e.g., EDGAR filing URL, CIK 0001543151, or accession no. 0001193125-26-012345
fields.description: Optional pointer to the exact registration statement if the company name alone is ambiguous.

fields.label: Upload filing documents
fields.accept_description: Optional: the prospectus, amendments, roadshow deck, or analyst pack. EDGAR is still used for the filing history.

fields.label: Deal stage
fields.description: Controls the valuation anchor. Auto-detect reads the EDGAR filing history to determine whether a range or final price exists.

options.value: Range set (marketing at a filed price range)
options.label: Range set (marketing at a filed price range)

fields.label: Sections to emphasize
fields.description: All sections run by default; selections receive extra depth.

options.label: Amendment-by-amendment change log
options.description: Price range moves, share count changes, new risk factors, restated figures across S-1/A filings

options.label: Offering terms and structure
options.description: Primary vs. secondary split, greenshoe, lockup expiry schedule, dual-class and governance

options.label: Dilution and share count build
options.description: Options and RSU overhang, converts, IPO-triggered vesting, fully diluted post-money share count

options.label: Growth quality
options.description: Cohorts, NRR definitions, concentration, marketing-adjusted vs. reported trends

options.label: Accounting read-through
options.description: Revenue recognition choices, non-GAAP bridge quality, SBC, capitalized costs, auditor flags

options.value: Risk factors and use of proceeds
options.label: Risk factors and use of proceeds
options.description: Informative vs. boilerplate risks; where the money actually goes

options.label: Valuation vs. comps
options.description: Implied multiples at low/mid/high of range on fully diluted post-money shares

options.label: Diligence questions
options.description: Prioritized question list tied to filing citations

fields.label: Comparable peers
fields.placeholder: e.g., SNOW, MDB, DDOG; or leave blank for auto-selection
fields.description: Public comps for the valuation grid. If blank, the workflow selects 5-10 peers and flags them for your review.

fields.label: Additional context
fields.placeholder: e.g., We are anchoring on the lockup supply schedule and SBC run-rate; compare the range to the 2024 Series G price per share.

fields.label: Data sources
fields.description: Select every data provider you want this run to draw on. Providers you have not connected are skipped gracefully and noted, so connecting them enriches the output. Perplexity Finance is always available.

options.label: Perplexity Finance (built-in)
options.description: Always available — live quotes, financials, estimates, transcripts, macro data

options.label: PitchBook
options.description: Private company rounds, valuations, cap tables, sponsor M&A — requires connected PitchBook

options.label: FactSet
options.description: Consensus estimates, fundamentals, ownership, M&A — requires connected FactSet

options.label: Daloopa
options.description: Analyst-grade historical fundamentals and KPIs with filing citations — requires connected Daloopa

options.label: Morningstar
options.description: Fundamentals, fair values, fund and ETF data — requires connected Morningstar

options.label: Carbon Arc (alt data)
options.description: Alternative data: demand and transaction signals to corroborate or challenge reported KPIs — requires connected Carbon Arc

options.label: Guidepoint (expert calls)
options.description: Expert interview transcripts: customers, competitors, former employees — requires connected Guidepoint
